messages:
joan: Need a small deliverable for launch: hero thumbnail (600x360), social card (1200x628), and a 3-frame GIF (600x360) showing the cost sparkline. Can design do light + dark variants and EN/DE copy?
kai: yes. Any constraints on copy length for DE?
joan: CMS limits: headline 60 chars, subhead 140 chars. German translations will be slightly longer so use responsive type and allow 2-line headlines.
lucy: noted. For GIF: subtle sparkline animate between frames, max 2MB, 10fps ok. Need a static PNG fallback.
kai: will create a single Figma file with pages for EN/DE and light/dark variants. Export presets for PNGs, SVG icons, and GIF. ETA Tue EOD.
joan: also include a small disclaimer frame: "Numbers are representative; see footnote" and include alt text snippets in the design file.
brand-ops: remember brand rules: logomark min 72px, color tokens only from theme palette, ensure 4.5:1 contrast on primary text.
figma-bot: Created file 'Launch / Compact Social Pack' and branch 'multilang-4395000000'  https://www.figma.com/file/ijkl9012/Launch-Compact-Social-Pack
kai: I'll drop first pass links here when ready. Will annotate variable fields for content ops to pull.
joan: great — once uploaded I'll add legal reviewers. Thanks! :rocket:
